integrity_notes: An analytic proof and standalone consistency checker are supplied; finite computations are not treated as universal proof. Earliest public source posted 2026-01-27.
scientific_limitations: Independent-Poisson finite multitype branching only; full support for the reproduction matrix, supercriticality; no finite epidemic predictions or uniqueness of the three-type crossover.
title: Three communities are sharp for transmissibility-dependent outbreak-source ranking reversals
